exposure: Mode of delivery (vaginal delivery vs. cesarean section)
outcome: Labor outcome (vaginal delivery vs. cesarean section)
cohort: Nulliparous women carrying singleton pregnancy at the onset of the active phase of labor
finding: Slower hourly progression rates of AoP, HSD, and PD at 1 and 2 hours from the initial assessment, as measured by transperineal ultrasound, were significantly associated with cesarean section for non-progressive labor.
mod_finding: The study aimed to predict labor outcome, specifically cesarean section for non-progressive labor, using transperineal ultrasound parameters.
